questions: Do you have shortness of breath, especially if it started suddenly or is worse when taking a deep breath?
Do you have any shortness of breath with coughing or breathing in that is sharp or worse with a deep breath (pleuritic pain), and if so, is it on one side?
Have you noticed any new leg swelling or pain (especially in one leg) or have you been immobilized/recently traveled/sustained surgery in the past 4 weeks?
While having the chest pain, do you have any episodes of fainting, sweating/clamminess, nausea, or pain that radiates to your left arm, jaw, or back?
answers: Yes, I feel significant dyspnea. It’s worse with my exertional symptoms, but it’s also been happening even at rest. It didn’t start suddenly like a new thing, it’s been ongoing with the chest pain.

I don’t have information about it being sharp specifically with deep breaths or coughing—I can’t say it’s pleuritic. It feels more like general chest tightness/heavy pain on both sides rather than one side only.
No, I haven’t noticed new leg swelling or one-leg pain. I also haven’t had recent travel, immobilization, or any surgery in the past 4 weeks.

Yes—during the chest pain I have significantly increased sweating. I also have left biceps radiating pain, and the pain feels like it goes up toward the thyroid cartilage/upper area with radiation to both shoulders. I don’t know about fainting, nausea, or pain to my jaw or back—I can’t confirm those.
